title: Artificial intelligence technologies for aging in place: a systematic review
title_zh: 人工智能技术在居家养老中的应用：系统综述
abstract: Abstract Populations worldwide are aging rapidly, and a growing number of older adults wish to remain in their own homes and communities rather than enter institutional care, an objective described as Aging in Place. Supporting Aging in Place is difficult because the needs it creates outstrip care resources, older adults at home require ongoing help with safety, health, daily activities, and social connection, yet the care workforce grows far more slowly than the population requiring care. Artificial intelligence has attracted attention for its scalability, automating monitoring, risk detection, and personalized support to extend the reach of a limited workforce. However, research on Artificial intelligence for Aging in Place remains fragmented across technical and gerontological communities, making it hard to see which technologies exist, how mature they are and how well they match older adults’ everyday needs. To address this gap, a general systematic review with descriptive mapping was conducted, searching six databases (MEDLINE, CINAHL, Web of Science, ProQuest Central, PubMed, and Scopus) for articles published between 2005 and June 2025. Following PRISMA guidelines, the search yielded 101 articles. Findings show research on Artificial intelligence for Aging in Place has grown rapidly, yet a persistent disparity remains between computational advancement and studies on real-world efficacy. The review introduces a four-category taxonomy that orders systems by algorithmic complexity and identifies five application scenarios through topic modeling. It proposes a three-layer organizing framework and a future research agenda that connect technical capability to gerontological need for Artificial intelligence supporting Aging in Place.
abstract_zh: 摘要：全球人口正在迅速老龄化，越来越多的老年人希望留在自己的家中和社区，而不是进入机构护理，这一目标被称为居家养老。支持居家养老具有挑战性，因为其需求超过了护理资源，居家老年人需要持续的安全、健康、日常活动和社交支持，而护理劳动力的增长远慢于需要护理的人口。人工智能因其可扩展性、自动化监测、风险检测和个性化支持而受到关注，可延伸有限劳动力的服务范围。然而，关于人工智能在居家养老中的研究在技术和老年学社区之间仍然碎片化，难以了解现有技术、成熟度以及与老年人日常需求的匹配程度。为填补这一空白，本文开展了一项通用系统综述并进行描述性映射，检索了六个数据库（MEDLINE、CINAHL、Web of Science、ProQuest Central、PubMed 和 Scopus），筛选了 2005 年至 2025 年 6 月间发表的文章。遵循 PRISMA 指南，搜索共获得 101 篇文章。研究结果显示，人工智能在居家养老领域的研究迅速增长，但在计算进步与真实世界效能研究之间仍存在显著差距。综述提出了四类分类法，根据算法复杂度对系统进行排序，并通过主题建模识别了五个应用场景。它提出了一个三层组织框架和未来研究议程，将技术能力与老年学需求相连接，以支持居家养老的人工智能应用。
